settings.headline: Usage data is billing data. We treat it that way.
settings.subtitle: How Abacene stores, isolates and retains your events, and what you can verify yourself. Abacene is fictional; these are illustrative controls, not certifications.

settings.headline: Controls
settings.intro: The short version. Each control is described in the customer security pack (story).

items.b: TLS 1.2+ in transit; AES-256 at rest for events, aggregates and invoices.
Per-account encryption keys; single-tenant deployments on Enterprise.
Closed invoices and rate card versions cannot be edited, only adjusted forward.
Every change to meters, rate cards, credits and invoices, with actor and time.
SAML 2.0 and OpenID Connect, with SSO-required mode.
Raw events 13 months; aggregates and invoices for the life of the account; export any time.

settings.headline: Where your usage data lives
settings.body:
Events are stored in the region you choose at sign-up (story regions: us-east, eu-west). Daily exports go to your own S3-compatible bucket, so you always hold a full copy.

Leaving is a documented process: export everything, verify counts against the reconciliation report, close the account.
settings.side: Cloud hosting, transactional email, and error monitoring. The list and its change notices are in the customer hub.
